notes: Handles EPUB and comic archive metadata extraction. Cleaned and verified by Idiom-reviewer (unexported XML structs, context check updates, error wrapping).

Client APIs for Audible, iTunes, Google Books, OpenLibrary, Audnexus. Cleaned and verified by Verifier. Reviewed and cleaned by Idiom-reviewer (wrapped all errors with %w, replaced deprecated strings.Title with custom unicode-safe toTitle, resolved potential timer leaks in retry loop, and optimized concurrent goroutine exit on context cancellation).

Handles OpenID Connect (OIDC) external authentication. Cleaned and verified by Idiom-reviewer (simplified context declarations, removed unused context import, checked memory management and SSRF safeClient). State parameter storage and safeClient configuration suggestions routed to porter.

Verified SMTP and Webhooks. Reviewed and cleaned by Idiom-reviewer. Fixed deferred cleanup bug in TestMain (temp crt file leak) and added robust context-cancellation/deadline support to SMTP Dial and I/O operations. Routed suggestions regarding SMTP port configuration, non-root tests, and Webhook HTTP client dependency injection back to porter.

Verified CRUD operations, sequential display ordering, dynamic database column checks, and media item type resolution. Addressed connection pool deadlocks by using unique shared-cache memory databases. Reviewed and cleaned by Idiom-reviewer (documented all exported identifiers, wrapped query and transaction errors with %w, added missing rows.Err checks, and preserved sql.ErrNoRows sentinel).

RSS podcast and OPML XML generation. Verified with a comprehensive test suite covering RSS XML headers, iTunes tags, playlist covers resolving to child items, range-request audio stream serving, and OPML generation with user permission access checks. Reviewed and cleaned by Idiom-reviewer (unexported internal XML/JSON helper structures, wrapped database/JSON/XML errors with %w, checked rows.Err() in all loop iterations, and threaded request context through table column checks).

Handles public share links, password hashes, and download access. Verified with unit tests covering SQLite memory DB initialization, CRUD, password validation (bcrypt), and expired share auto-cleanup. Reviewed and cleaned by Idiom-reviewer (logged DB initialization and expired share deletion errors instead of swallowing them silently).

Coordinates search requests across all registered providers. Verified routing, concurrent search of all providers, fail-silent behavior under provider failure, region fallback mapping (e.g. audible.ca -> audible), and case-insensitivity. Reviewed and cleaned by Idiom-reviewer (documented exported Finder struct, lowercased provider mapping keys for robust case-insensitivity, fixed parent context cancellation checks, suppressed provider failure logs during context cancellation, refactored concurrent search tests to be 100% deterministic, and added context cancellation test coverage).

Verified unit tests for SQLite db connection, dynamic PRAGMA column checks, mock RSS feeds (UTF-8 and ISO-8859-1), download media streaming, duplicate filename resolution, redirect fallbacks, and the cron/ticker background sync runner. Cleaned, idiomaticized, and verified by Idiom-reviewer (documented exported structs, wrapped XML and DB scan errors, checked rows.Err() in all rows loop iterations, added logging for database operation and download failures, context cancellation check inside feed loop, and safe connection body closing in upgraded redirect fallback).
